error_chain: Prisma's prisma generate runs the engine to produce DMMF; the DMMF's Model.fields array preserves source-file declaration order
zod-prisma (third-party generator that consumes prisma's DMMF) walks fields in array order and emits z.object({...}) keys in that order
zod's z.object internally stores shape as a plain object whose key iteration order matches insertion (per ECMAScript 2015+ spec)

When zod-prisma emits a discriminated union via z.discriminatedUnion, the discriminator key resolution depends on shape iteration order; a reorder in schema.prisma can change which variant zod picks for ambiguous payloads
Different services that regenerated at different times (one before, one after the reorder) emit different zod schemas, leading to validation drift
trigger_conditions: Customer reordered fields in schema.prisma (perhaps to group related fields) and not all services regenerated zod schemas at the same time
zod's z.discriminatedUnion behavior depends on shape iteration order; reordering shape keys changes which variant matches an ambiguous input
Prisma's DMMF preserves source order, propagating the reorder into zod-prisma's emitted shape

expected_answer.error_origin: Prisma's DMMF preserving schema.prisma source order, which zod-prisma maps directly into shape iteration order in zod's z.object
expected_answer.bypass_reason: zod's discriminated-union resolution is shape-iteration-order dependent for ambiguous payloads; field reorder = different variant selection
expected_answer.correct_config: Pin the field order in schema.prisma alphabetically (or by a documented convention) and regenerate all services from the same Prisma version, or replace z.discriminatedUnion with z.union plus an explicit discriminator check
